$description: Mode-independent tokens: type, spacing, sizing, radius, border width, motion. Color and elevation live in tokens/light.json and tokens/dark.json, and raw palette values in the theme file; tokens.resolver.json combines them. Product code consumes semantic roles (type.*, space.*, size.*, radius.*, motion.*, color.*, elevation.*), not primitives marked as such.

font.$description: Primitives. Product styles use the type.* roles instead.

ui.$description: Product UI typeface: the platform's system font. Do not change or extend this stack.

mono.$description: Only for content that needs character distinction: IDs, hashes, code, machine-generated values. Not for file sizes or other plain numbers; use tabular numerals for aligned numbers.

type.$description: Semantic type roles. Pick by role, not by size. A font change needs a content reason.

entity.$description: Identity of a single entity on its detail page, such as an asset's name. Not for ordinary screens.

page.$description: Title of an application screen. At most one per screen. Large and bold, so the screen has one clear anchor while everything below it stays quiet.

section.$description: Names a section, only when the section needs a name.

strong.$description: Only for what must be found first inside body text, such as an upload summary.

default.$description: Dense repeated rows: filenames and metadata. Hierarchy within a row comes from color (text.primary vs text.secondary), not size or weight.

space.$description: Spacing scale plus semantic spacing. Spend space between regions, not inside repeated rows.

region.$description: Between page regions: page heading, controls, results.

group.$description: Between related groups inside one region.

control-gap.$description: Between adjacent controls in a toolbar or action group.

inline.$description: Horizontal padding inside a dense row.

gap.$description: Between cells in a dense row, such as thumbnail and filename.

inline.$description: Page side margin on wide layouts.

inline-compact.$description: Page side margin on narrow layouts.

dense.$description: Row height in dense lists on pointer layouts. Starting value; validate against fixtures.

touch.$description: Minimum size of any interactive target on touch layouts, rows included.

default.$description: Button and input height on pointer layouts.

list.$description: Asset thumbnail inside a dense row.

radius.$description: Radius only where shape communicates something. There is deliberately no radius for sections or cards.

motion.$description: Motion explains a state change; it never decorates. Under reduced motion, use duration.reduced.

default.$description: Menus, popovers, rows entering or leaving.

reduced.$description: Replaces other durations when the user prefers reduced motion.

standard.$description: Elements moving or changing within the screen.

enter.$description: Elements appearing, such as a menu opening from its trigger.
